dedupe_keys.name: enverus energy data and analytics commercial oil gas and power data platform

description: Enverus is a commercial provider of energy data, analytics and software. Its home page, read on 2026-09-26, describes solutions for utilities, data centres, renewable developers, engineering firms, power traders, oil and gas operators, oilfield services, midstream, minerals, financial services and consultants, an AI product it says is backed by the most complete energy dataset and trusted by more than 8,000 companies, the Enverus ONE workflow platform across land, finance, operations, trading and power, and tools for inventory economics, generation siting, deal screening and land document extraction. Coverage and content of the underlying data are not itemised on the home page; the candidate came from a data paper that reviewed sources of oil and gas infrastructure data. Access is by paid subscription, with formats and licence terms set in contracts, so the data are not open. Caveats: only the promotional home page was read, the claims on it were not checked, and research reuse is limited by licence terms. Simulation uses are asset inventories of wells, pipelines and facilities for capacity planning and investment optimisation where open sources are incomplete. Related records: data-ogim-oil-gas-infrastructure-mapping is an open global oil and gas infrastructure inventory, and data-netl-gogi-global-oil-gas-features-database is NETL's open database.
